project.name: Groundworks Customization
project.description: Microsoft Business Central AL extension by RSM US LLP for Groundworks. Version 24.0.0.16 targeting BC platform 24.

nodes.name: AL Table Dictionary Template
nodes.summary: VS Code AL snippet template for creating new Dictionary-style tables with Code and Description fields. Provides a scaffold for GDPR data classification selection during table creation.

nodes.name: AL Table Entry Template
nodes.summary: VS Code AL snippet template for creating new Entry-style tables with standard entry fields (Entry No., Document No., Description, Quantity, Amount, User ID, Dimension Set ID). Provides scaffolding with GDPR data classification selection.

nodes.name: VS Code Launch Configuration
nodes.summary: Defines multiple AL debug/launch targets against the groundworks.co Business Central tenant (UAT, Transaction_Clear, WHIIMPBRANCH, UATFinal, DEV environments). All targets use tenant ID a74ffa35-a177-437c-986d-95b321df97d4 with sandbox environment type.

nodes.name: RSM AL Ruleset
nodes.summary: Custom AL code analysis ruleset for RSM development standards. Suppresses five specific CodeCop rules (AA0215, AA0214, AA0005, AA0218, AA0072) to accommodate RSM naming conventions and coding style preferences.

nodes.name: VS Code Workspace Settings
nodes.summary: Workspace-level VS Code settings enabling AL code analysis (CodeCop + PerTenantExtensionCop), format-on-save, the RSM custom ruleset, and CRS file naming conventions with the RSMUS object name prefix.

nodes.name: App Manifest (app.json)
nodes.summary: BC extension manifest for Groundworks Customization by RSM US LLP, version 24.0.0.16 targeting BC platform 24 (cloud). Declares object ID range 50100-99999 and dependencies on Zetadocs, Dynamic Ship, IWorks Common, License Plate Management, and Warehouse Insight Advanced WMS.

nodes.name: Extensions Permission Set XML
nodes.summary: Legacy XML permission set definition (RoleID: GROUNDWORKS CUSTOMIZATION) granting RIMD access to all custom tables (IDs 50100+) and Execute access to all custom codeunits, pages, reports, and queries in the extension.

nodes.name: Web Service Publishing Configuration
nodes.summary: Defines a single published web service exposing codeunit 50503 (IntegrationFunctions) as 'IntegrationFunctions' for the Groundworks tenant.

nodes.name: RSMUSRSMPermission (PermissionSet 50102)
nodes.summary: Assignable AL permission set granting full RIMD access to all custom RSMUS tables, execute access to all custom codeunits, reports, pages, xmlports, and queries in the extension. Covers assembly, integration, inventory, job, transfer, and warehouse objects.

nodes.name: Source Root README
nodes.summary: RSM AL development notes covering event subscriber conventions, table/page extension ID requirements, sister-table field rules, and a link to full RSM development standards on SharePoint.

nodes.name: Codeunit README â€” Event Subscriber Naming
nodes.summary: Documents the naming conventions for event subscriber codeunits in the extension (General, Purch., Sales, Whse. & Mfg., Service).

nodes.name: Report README â€” Layout Path Convention
nodes.summary: Documents the RDLC layout path convention for report objects: layouts must reside in src/Report/Layouts/ and follow the report object name.

nodes.name: RSMUSItemType (Enum 50100)
nodes.summary: Extensible AL enum classifying items as blank, Product, or Material. Used to distinguish item roles in job planning and BizWiz integration contexts.

nodes.name: RSMUSIntegrationStatus (Enum 50101)
nodes.summary: Extensible AL enum representing the lifecycle states of an integration record: Nothing, Pending, Complete, Error. Used to track external integration sync status.

nodes.name: RSMUSYesNoBlank (Enum 50102)
nodes.summary: Extensible AL enum providing a three-value Yes/No/Blank option set for fields requiring a nullable boolean representation.

nodes.name: RSMUSWorkflowStatus (Enum 50103)
nodes.summary: Extensible AL enum representing document workflow lifecycle states: Open, Pending Approval, Released, Posted. Used to control document processing flow in custom workflows.

nodes.name: RSMUSBizWizSyncStatuses (Enum 50104)
nodes.summary: Extensible AL enum for BizWiz/NopCommerce synchronization states: blank, Pending, In Progress, Success, Error. Tracks the sync lifecycle for records pushed to or pulled from the BizWiz integration.

nodes.name: RSMUS Step Option (Enum 50105)
nodes.summary: Extensible AL enum for assembly process step timing options: Start, End, Pause Start, Pause End. Part of the Assembly and Pick Streamlining feature (BRD-0003).

nodes.name: RSMUS Assembly Order Status (Enum 50106)
nodes.summary: Extensible AL enum for assembly order lifecycle states: Open, InProgress, Pause, Finished. Part of the Assembly and Pick Streamlining feature (BRD-0003).

nodes.name: RSMUS Process Pick Option (Enum 50107)
nodes.summary: Extensible AL enum controlling when pick processing occurs in an assembly workflow: None, At Start, At End. Part of the Assembly and Pick Streamlining feature (BRD-0003).

nodes.name: RSMUSJobStatus (EnumExtension 50100 of Job Status 1619)
nodes.summary: Enum extension on the standard BC Job Status enum (1619) adding a blank value (50100) to allow jobs to have an unset/blank status in custom scenarios.

nodes.name: RSMUSPostedSalesInvoiceLines (Page 50109 â€” API)
nodes.summary: Read-only OData v4 API page (rsmus/gw/v2.0) exposing posted sales invoice lines with key fields including customer, document, line, and job references. Supports change tracking via systemId.

nodes.name: RSMUSJobDetail (Query 50100 â€” API)
nodes.summary: Read-only OData v4 API query (rsmus/gw/v2.0) exposing job planning line detail including BizWiz sync status fields (RSMUSBizWizSyncStatus, sync timestamps) and custom RSMUS item type. Upper-level Job/JobTask dataitem structure is currently commented out.

nodes.name: RSMUSCustomerLedgerEntries (Query 50101, API v2.0)
nodes.summary: API query that joins Customer and open Cust. Ledger Entry records, exposing invoice/payment data including amounts, due dates, and branch (Global Dimension 1) to BizWiz via rsmus/gw/v2.0/customerLedgerEntries.

nodes.name: RSMUSExtensionInstall (Codeunit 50100)
nodes.summary: Extension install codeunit (Subtype=Install) that runs on per-company installation. All active logic is commented out; the codeunit is effectively a placeholder retaining historical upgrade procedures for report selections, job planning lines, SKU status, and portal sync.

nodes.name: RSMUSProcessTranHdr (Codeunit 50101)
nodes.summary: Event subscriber codeunit that listens to Transfer Line insert/modify events and to the custom RSMUStransferHeaderBuffer insert event in order to create or update Transfer Headers from integration buffer data, and to sync the drop-ship purchase order number onto the related Purchase Header.

nodes.name: RSMUSProcessTransferLines (Codeunit 50102)
nodes.summary: Event subscriber that fires when a record is inserted into the RSMUStransferLineBuffer table and creates the corresponding Transfer Line on the actual Transfer Order, deduplicating against existing lines by count comparison.

nodes.name: RSMUSPODropShipManagement (Codeunit 50103)
nodes.summary: Manages drop-shipment logic on Transfer Orders: defaults the drop-ship flag from item/SKU configuration when an item is validated, zeroes the transfer line quantity for drop-ship lines, and automatically generates Purchase Orders grouped by vendor when the Transfer Order is released.

nodes.name: RSMUSGeneral Event Subscribers (Codeunit 50104)
nodes.summary: Large general-purpose event subscriber codeunit covering items, SKUs, jobs, item categories, general journal lines, approval workflows, warehouse shipments, license plate headers, transfer shipment lines, and sales lines; delegates most business logic to RSMUSGeneral Management (50105) and RSMUSInactiveCustomer (50107).

nodes.name: RSMUSGeneral Management (Codeunit 50105)
nodes.summary: Core general management codeunit providing shared utility procedures: SKU blocked/portal status synchronisation, item No.2 duplicate checking, item category hierarchy inheritance, location-to-branch dimension lookup, general journal line dimension defaulting from sales invoices, and approval workflow status management for journal batches, vendors, and items.

nodes.name: RSMUSSales Event Subscribers (Codeunit 50106)
nodes.summary: Sales-domain event subscriber codeunit that handles post-sales-posting deposit application, tracks DraftInvoiceLineSystemId on Sales Lines, propagates location-to-branch dimension on Sales Lines, and updates Job modify flags from Sales Invoice/Credit Memo line events; includes a callable ButtonApplyDeposit procedure for manual deposit application.

nodes.name: RSMUSInactiveCustomer (Codeunit 50107)
nodes.summary: Small utility codeunit with a single procedure that marks a Customer as inactive (RSMUSActive = false) when all of its Jobs are set to Completed status.

nodes.name: RSMUS Inventory Mgmt. (Codeunit 50108)
nodes.summary: Inventory management utility codeunit providing two procedures: ItemJournalLineAddLocationDim adds the location-derived branch dimension to an Item Journal Line, and CustomCheckWhseClass bypasses warehouse class checks for special location bins (receipt, shipment, adjustment, production, assembly, job bins).

nodes.name: RSMUSWhse. & Mfg. Event Subs (Codeunit 50109)
nodes.summary: Warehouse and manufacturing event subscriber that copies comments to posted warehouse shipment headers, populates Foreman/Inspector fields on WHI Document List Buffer from Job Planning Lines, forces shelf/bin sort order on warehouse shipment pick creation, and delegates warehouse class checks to RSMUS Inventory Mgmt.

nodes.name: RSMUS Inventory Events (Codeunit 50110)
nodes.summary: Minimal event subscriber that fires after Calculate Inventory inserts an Item Journal Line and delegates to RSMUS Inventory Mgmt to add the location dimension to the line.

nodes.name: RSMUS Job Mgmt (Codeunit 50111)
nodes.summary: Core job management codeunit providing procedures for creating inventory pick/movement documents for Job Planning Lines, calculating available-to-take quantity, handling warehouse activity line deletion and pick posting, implementing over-pick processing with threshold validation, and setting Foreman/Inspector on Job Ledger Entries.

nodes.name: RSMUS Job Events (Codeunit 50112)
nodes.summary: Job-domain event subscriber codeunit that fires on Warehouse Activity Line, Posted Invt. Pick Line, Job Ledger Entry, Job, Job Task, and Job Planning Line events, delegating all business logic to RSMUS Job Mgmt (50111) and calling BC-extended table procedures for location and field population.

nodes.name: RSMUSPurchaseEventSubscribers (Codeunit 50113)
nodes.summary: Purchase-domain event subscriber codeunit that stamps the creator ID on new Purchase Orders, applies location-to-branch dimension on Purchase Lines, defaults the Ship-To option to Location on the Purchase Order page, and forces Receive-only posting (suppressing Invoice) on confirmation and batch post events.

nodes.name: RSMUS Assembly Process Mgt (Codeunit 50114)
nodes.summary: Complex assembly process management codeunit implementing the full lifecycle (Start, Pause, End) of custom RSMUS Assembly Order Processes: creates and registers warehouse picks, posts assembly orders, handles rework via warehouse movement, calculates quantities to pick, archives completed process records, and manages step/job numbering.

nodes.name: RSMUSGenLedgEventSubscribers (Codeunit 50115)
nodes.summary: General ledger event subscriber codeunit that intercepts GL Entry buffer inserts to redirect customer deposit postings to the unearned revenue GL account, propagates the customer deposit flag and vendor field to GL and Customer Ledger Entries.

nodes.name: RSMUSActionHandler (Codeunit 50116)
nodes.summary: Notification action handler codeunit with a single procedure that displays error details from a BizWiz update failure notification; most of the original navigation logic is commented out.

nodes.name: RSMUS Assembly Process Events (Codeunit 50117)
nodes.summary: Assembly process event subscriber codeunit that overrides Assembly Line pick quantity calculation (delegating to RSMUS Assembly Process Mgt), validates new Assembly Order Process records, enforces step date/time stamping, blocks deletion of active Assembly Orders, and validates quantity fields on the Assembly Order Process record.

nodes.name: RSMUSWHIEventOverrides (Codeunit 50118)
nodes.summary: WHI (Warehouse Integration) event override codeunit that intercepts WHI custom function events to implement over-pick processing: looks up the Warehouse Activity Line by document/line number from the WHI event parameters and delegates to RSMUS Job Mgmt for over-pick quantity validation.

nodes.name: RSMUS BankRecAutoMatch (Codeunit 50119)
nodes.summary: Bank reconciliation event subscriber that overrides the standard OnBeforeMatchSingle event to completely replace the auto-match algorithm, delegating to RSMUSMatchBankRecLinesV2, and also filters bank rec lines by document number during the OnFindBestMatches event.

nodes.name: RSMUSBankAccEntrySetReconNoV2 (Codeunit 50120)
nodes.summary: Custom copy of the standard BankAccEntrySetReconNo codeunit providing ApplyEntries, RemoveApplication, SetReconNo, and RemoveReconNo procedures for bank reconciliation line-to-ledger-entry matching across one-to-one, one-to-many, and many-to-one relations, with integration events for extensibility.

nodes.name: RSMUSMatchBankRecLinesV2 (Codeunit 50121)
nodes.summary: Custom copy of the standard MatchBankRecLines codeunit implementing the full bank reconciliation auto-match algorithm with separate passes for 'Paid Check' transactions (matched by document number and amount) and all other transactions (matched by amount and date tolerance), plus manual match/remove-match procedures and text similarity scoring.

nodes.name: OneTimeFunctionFixv24Upgrade (Codeunit 50122)
nodes.summary: Stub codeunit created to hold a v24 upgrade fix (clearing Service Connections); all logic is commented out and the Install subtype is removed, leaving an empty codeunit.

nodes.name: RSMUSWorkdayImport (Codeunit 50501)
nodes.summary: Web-service-enabled codeunit exposing a single ServiceEnabled procedure JournalLineImport that accepts a Base64-encoded CSV payload, decodes it, and runs the RSMUSWorkdayImport XmlPort to import journal lines from Workday.

nodes.name: RSMUSBizWizIntegration (Codeunit 50500)
nodes.summary: Primary BizWiz integration engine handling HTTP outbound calls (sales invoices, customer ledger entries, job completions), event subscribers on Job, Job Task, Job Planning Line, Location, and Sales tables, plus material association management, Excel import/export helpers, and sync-status utilities. It is the largest and most complex codeunit in the extension at ~1958 lines.

nodes.name: RSMUSSingleInstanceCU (Codeunit 50502)
nodes.summary: Single-instance codeunit acting as an in-memory state store: tracks preview mode, marked customer ledger entries, assembly order process flags, temporary job planning lines, and warehouse shipment line available-qty tracking; also contains event subscribers that control warehouse shipment line creation and auto-reservation logic for completed jobs.

nodes.name: RSMUSIntegrationFunctions (Codeunit 50503)
nodes.summary: Handles automated job-complete costing: finds BizWiz-completed jobs, generates resource job journal lines, opens/closes jobs, attempts to post journal lines (moving failures to an error batch), optionally runs WIP calculation, and returns a JSON summary of total/complete/error counts.

nodes.name: RSMUSWorkdayImport (XMLport 50100)
nodes.summary: CSV-format XMLport that imports Workday general ledger data (posting date, account, description, debit/credit amounts, branch/dimension) into the RSMUSWorkdayImportBuffer table, reading journal template and batch from Integration Setup.

nodes.name: RSMUSJobTaskDimensions (Page 50504, API v2.0)
nodes.summary: Read/write API page exposing Job Task Dimension records (job no., task no., dimension code, value) to external consumers such as BizWiz via OData/API endpoint rsmus/gw/v2.0/jobTaskDimensions.

nodes.name: RSMUSAttachments (Page 50507, API â€” commented out)
nodes.summary: Fully commented-out API page that was designed to accept base64-encoded document attachments from BizWiz and insert them as BC Document Attachment records; currently inactive.

nodes.name: RSMUSCustomerPostingGroups (Page 50525, API v2.0)
nodes.summary: Read-only API page exposing Customer Posting Group code and description to BizWiz via OData endpoint rsmus/gw/v2.0/custPostingGroups; insert, modify, and delete are all disallowed.

nodes.name: RSMUSItemCategories (Page 50526, API v2.0)
nodes.summary: API page over a temporary RSMUSItemCategoryBuffer that mirrors the Item Category table; on GET it loads all categories, and on insert/modify/delete it delegates to buffer record procedures while restricting operations to product-type items only.

nodes.name: RSMUSUnitOfMeasure (Page 50529, API v2.0)
nodes.summary: Read-only API page exposing Unit of Measure records (code, description, international standard code, symbol, SAT classification) to BizWiz; insert, modify, and delete are disallowed.

nodes.name: RSMUSJobBatchErrors (Page 50532, API v2.0)
nodes.summary: Parent API page (batch envelope) that groups jobErrors, jobTaskErrors, and jobPlanningLineErrors as sub-parts, allowing BizWiz to post a batch of sync error records in a single request to rsmus/gw/v2.0/jobBatchErrors.

nodes.name: RSMUSJobErrors (Page 50533, API v2.0)
nodes.summary: API page that receives BizWiz sync error notifications for Job records; on insert it locates the Job by system ID and sets its BizWiz sync status to Error along with the error message and last sync datetime.

nodes.name: RSMUSJobTaskErrors (Page 50534, API v2.0)
nodes.summary: API page that receives BizWiz sync error notifications for Job Task records; on insert it finds the Job Task by system ID and marks its BizWiz sync status as Error with a sync datetime.

nodes.name: RSMUSJobPlanningLineErrors (Page 50535, API v2.0)
nodes.summary: API page that receives BizWiz sync error notifications for Job Planning Line records; on insert it sets the planning line and its parent job task to Error sync status, propagating the error upward.

nodes.name: RSMUSJobBatchClearErrors (Page 50536, API v2.0)
nodes.summary: Parent API page (batch envelope) for clearing error status, embedding jobClearErrors as a sub-part; allows BizWiz to submit a batch clear request to rsmus/gw/v2.0/jobBatchClearErrors.

nodes.name: RSMUSJobClearErrors (Page 50537, API v2.0)
nodes.summary: API page that clears BizWiz sync error status on a Job and all its related Job Tasks and Job Planning Lines, resetting their sync status to Success and clearing the error message blob.

nodes.name: RSMUSPostingDates (Page 50538, API v2.0)
nodes.summary: Read-only API page that exposes the effective GL posting date range (from/to) for the current user by combining General Ledger Setup and User Setup posting date rules, allowing BizWiz to query the allowed posting window.

nodes.name: RSMUSCustomers API (Page 50500)
nodes.summary: API page exposing the Customer table to BizWiz. Provides customer master data including system ID, customer number, name, address, contact details, payment terms, shipping info, and custom RSMUS fields (No. 2). Read/write enabled with change tracking. Part of rsmus/gw API group v2.0.

nodes.name: RSMUSStockkeepingUnits API (Page 50501)
nodes.summary: API page exposing the Stockkeeping Unit table to BizWiz. Provides SKU data including item number, location code, unit cost, item type, description, blocked status, item category, and last modified date. Read-only (InsertAllowed=false, ModifyAllowed=false). Part of rsmus/gw API group v2.0.

nodes.name: RSMUSJobs API (Page 50502)
nodes.summary: API page exposing the Job table to BizWiz. Provides job master data including job number, description, bill-to customer, status, dates, custom RSMUS fields (No. 2), and job financials. Read/write enabled with change tracking. Central entity for job management integration. Part of rsmus/gw API group v2.0.

nodes.name: RSMUSJobTaskLines API (Page 50503)
nodes.summary: API page exposing the Job Task table to BizWiz. Provides job task data including job number, task number, description, task type, start/end dates, foreman, inspector, and custom RSMUS description 2. Supports Foreman and Inspector fields (BRD-0019). Part of rsmus/gw API group v2.0.

nodes.name: RSMUSJobPlanningLines API (Page 50505) [Disabled]
nodes.summary: API page definition for job planning lines backed by RSMUSJobPlanningLineBuffer temporary table. Entirely commented out â€” this endpoint is disabled/legacy and replaced by RSMUSJobPlanningLinesV2 (Page 50531). Originally targeted rsmus/gw v1.0. No active fields are exposed.

nodes.name: RSMUSSalesInvoiceSubform API (Page 50509)
nodes.summary: API page exposing Sales Invoice Lines (Sales Line table filtered to Invoice document type) to BizWiz. Provides line-level data including document number, line number, type, item/resource number, description, quantities, unit prices, amounts, job references, and dimensions. Read-only (InsertAllowed=false, ModifyAllowed=false). Part of rsmus/gw API group v2.0.

nodes.name: RSMUSJobJournal API (Page 50520)
nodes.summary: API page exposing job journal lines to BizWiz via the RSMUSJobJournalLineBuffer temporary table. Provides journal entry data including posting date, document number, job number, job task number, type, quantity, unit cost, and line type. Supports posting job usage from BizWiz. Part of rsmus/gw API group v2.0.

nodes.name: RSMUSItem API (Page 50523)
nodes.summary: API page exposing item master data to BizWiz via the RSMUSItemBuffer temporary table. Provides item fields including base unit of measure, costing method, description, item category, type, unit cost, unit price, and other item attributes. Read/write with change tracking. Part of rsmus/gw API group v2.0.

nodes.name: RSMUSMaterialPlanningLines API (Page 50530)
nodes.summary: API page exposing material planning lines to BizWiz via RSMUSJobPlanningLineBuffer temporary table. Provides planning line data including job number, task number, line number, line type, planning date, type, item/resource number, description, and quantities. Insert-only from BizWiz (ModifyAllowed=false, DeleteAllowed=false). Part of rsmus/gw API group v2.0.

nodes.name: RSMUSJobPlanningLinesV2 API (Page 50531)
nodes.summary: API page exposing job planning lines to BizWiz via RSMUSJobPlanningLineBuffer temporary table. Version 2 replacement for the disabled Page 50505. Provides full planning line data including job/task references, line type, planning date, type, item/resource, quantities, unit cost/price, and billable amounts. Full read/write/delete access. Part of rsmus/gw API group v2.0.

nodes.name: RSMUSSalesInvoice API Page
nodes.summary: NopCommerce API page (rsmus/gw/v2.0) exposing sales invoices via the 'salesInvoices' entity set. Sourced from the Sales Header table filtered to Invoice document type. Read-only (InsertAllowed=false, ModifyAllowed=false). Exposes comprehensive sales invoice fields including customer, addresses, shipping, pricing, and totals to NopCommerce for order synchronization.

nodes.name: RSMUSTransferHeaderList List Page
nodes.summary: Non-API list page (PageType=List) displaying transfer header buffer records from the RSMUStransferHeaderBuffer table. Shows transfer-from/to codes, posting date, status, and comments. Serves as a UI browse view for buffered transfer order headers used in the NopCommerce integration.

nodes.name: RSMUSTransferHeaderBuffer API Page
nodes.summary: NopCommerce POST API endpoint (rsmus/gw/v2.0) for the 'bufferTransferHeaders' entity set. Sources from RSMUStransferHeaderBuffer table and accepts inbound transfer order header data from NopCommerce. Includes an inline subpage for buffer transfer lines linked by header number.

nodes.name: RSMUSTransferLineBuffer API Page
nodes.summary: NopCommerce POST API endpoint (rsmus/gw/v2.0) for the 'bufferTransferLines' entity set. Sources from RSMUStransferLineBuffer table, exposing item number, quantity, and unit of measure for inbound transfer line data from NopCommerce.

nodes.name: RSMUSWarehouseShipmentHeader API Page
nodes.summary: NopCommerce GET API endpoint (rsmus/gw/v2.0) for the 'warehouseShipmentHeaders' entity set. Sources from the standard BC Warehouse Shipment Header table. Exposes shipment date, external document number, shipping agent code, comments, and an inline subpage of warehouse shipment lines.

nodes.name: RSMUSWarehouseShipmentLine API Page
nodes.summary: NopCommerce GET API endpoint (rsmus/gw/v2.0) for the 'warehouseShipmentLines' entity set. Sources from the standard BC Warehouse Shipment Line table. Exposes source number, item number, and quantity shipped for shipment line detail consumed by NopCommerce.

nodes.name: RSMUSTransferLineList List Page
nodes.summary: Non-API list page (PageType=List) displaying transfer line buffer records from the RSMUStransferLineBuffer table. Shows item number, quantity, and unit of measure. UI browse companion to the buffer transfer line API endpoint.

nodes.name: RSMUSTransferHeader API Page
nodes.summary: NopCommerce GET API endpoint (rsmus/gw/v2.0) for the 'transferHeaders' entity set. Sources from the standard BC Transfer Header table. Exposes transfer-from/to codes, posting date, status, and an inline subpage of transfer lines linked by document number.

nodes.name: RSMUSTransferLine API Page
nodes.summary: NopCommerce GET API endpoint (rsmus/gw/v2.0) for the 'transferLines' entity set. Sources from the standard BC Transfer Line table. Exposes item number, quantity, quantity shipped, quantity received, and unit of measure for transfer line detail.

nodes.name: RSMUSTransferShipmentHeader API Page
nodes.summary: NopCommerce GET API endpoint (rsmus/gw/v2.0) for the 'transferShipmentHeaders' entity set. Sources from the BC Transfer Header table and represents shipment-oriented view. Exposes transfer-from/to codes, posting date, shipment date, and an inline subpage of transfer shipment lines.

nodes.name: RSMUSShipmentTransferLine API Page
nodes.summary: NopCommerce GET API endpoint (rsmus/gw/v2.0) for the 'transferShipmentLines' entity set. Sources from the BC Transfer Line table, providing shipment-oriented line detail including item number, quantity, quantity shipped, quantity received, and unit of measure.

nodes.name: RSMUSCommentLines API Page
nodes.summary: NopCommerce API endpoint (rsmus/gw/v2.0) for the 'whsCommentLines' entity set. Sources from the standard BC Warehouse Comment Line table. Exposes comment date, comment text, and line number for warehouse document comment lines. Designed to be used as a subpage of warehouse shipment headers.

nodes.name: RSMUSPstedWhseShipmentHeader API Page
nodes.summary: NopCommerce GET API endpoint (rsmus/gw/v2.0) for the 'pstedWarehouseShipmentHeaders' entity set. Sources from the BC Posted Whse. Shipment Header table. Exposes shipment date, external document number, shipping agent code, shipping agent name (custom field), comments, and an inline subpage of posted warehouse shipment lines.

nodes.name: RSMUSIntegrationSetup Card Page
nodes.summary: Central administration card page for all integration configuration in the Groundworks BC extension. Manages BizWiz setup (credentials, job templates, batch names, flags for active integration, job planning restrictions, invoice tracking, WIP costing), Workday integration settings (API credentials, endpoints, journal templates), NopCommerce settings, and general integration flags. Uses RSMUSIntegrationSetup as its source table and invokes RSMUSBizWizIntegration and RSMUSGeneralManagement codeunits.

nodes.name: RSMUSBizWizSubcategories List Page
nodes.summary: Administration list page displaying BizWiz subcategories (IMG categories) in a hierarchical tree view, sourced from the RSMUSBizWizSubcategory table sorted by presentation order. Supports recalculation of the category tree structure and links to the subcategory card page.

nodes.name: RSMUSBizWizSubcategoryCard Card Page
nodes.summary: Card page for maintaining individual BizWiz subcategory records, sourced from RSMUSBizWizSubcategory. Displays code, description, and parent category. Includes a custom Delete action with confirmation, guards deletion when child records exist, and recalculates presentation order on close.

nodes.name: RSMUSWorkdayImport List Page
nodes.summary: List page for reviewing Workday import buffer records from RSMUSWorkdayImportBuffer. Shows entry number, status, creation date, comments, journal template/batch, G/L account, posting date, document date/type/number, description, amount, and global dimension 1. Read-only view of inbound Workday journal data staged for BC posting.

nodes.name: ProductMaterialAssocSubform ListPart Page
nodes.summary: Subform list part displaying product-to-material associations from the RSMUSProductMaterialAssoc table. Shows material item number, description, quantity, and unit of measure (linked to Item Unit of Measure). Location code and variant code fields are present but hidden. Embedded in other pages to manage job or product material assignments.

nodes.name: RSMUSJobPlanningPrefilters StandardDialog Page
nodes.summary: Standard dialog page for pre-filtering job planning lines before batch job costing operations. Accepts job number and customer number filter criteria, then applies them to Job Planning Line records and opens the RSMUSJobPlanningLineSimpleView page showing only material-type lines for the matched jobs. Used in BizWiz job costing workflows.

nodes.name: RSMUSCustomerPaymentPrefilters StandardDialog Page
nodes.summary: Standard dialog page for selecting a date range (start date and end date) before sending customer payments, credit memos, refunds, and finance charges to BizWiz. Validates that start date is not after end date, defaults start date to today, and exposes filter getter procedures used by the calling process.

nodes.name: RSMUS Invoices Process Log List Page
nodes.summary: Read-only list page displaying process log entries from the RSMUS Process Log table. Shows entry number, process identifier, process name, start time, end time, and duration in milliseconds. Used for monitoring and auditing invoice processing runs in the BizWiz/NopCommerce integration.

nodes.name: RSMUSOne Time Functions List Page
nodes.summary: Administration utility page providing one-time data fix actions, using a temporary Error Message table as its source for output display. Contains a 'Fix Qty To Receive on Transfer Orders' action that corrects derived transfer lines on a specific transfer order. Intended for one-off data correction operations.

nodes.name: RSMUSPstedWhsShipmentLine API Page
nodes.summary: NopCommerce GET API endpoint (rsmus/gw/v2.0) for the 'pstedWarehouseShipmentLines' entity set. Sources from the BC Posted Whse. Shipment Line table. Exposes source number, item number, and quantity for posted warehouse shipment line detail consumed by NopCommerce.

nodes.name: RSMUSJobTaskLinesSubform
nodes.summary: Extends the Job Task Lines Subform to add BizWiz sync status, Foreman, Inspector, Location Code, Work Description, and BizWiz Task Type fields. Also adds a 'Material Job Costing' action to open job planning lines filtered by the current task.

nodes.name: RSMUSJobPlanningLines
nodes.summary: Extends Job Planning Lines with BizWiz sync fields, foreman/inspector columns, item type, available bin quantity, and overpicking quantity fields. Adds actions to create inventory picks, add associated materials from product-material associations, view bin contents, and run a custom Job Planning Lines report.

nodes.name: RSMUSCustomerPostingGroups

nodes.name: RSMUSPostedPurchaseInvoice

nodes.name: RSMUSPostedSalesInvoices

nodes.name: RSMUSPostedPurchaseInvoices

nodes.name: RSMUSLocationList

nodes.name: RSMUSGeneralLedgerEntries

nodes.name: RSMUSCustomerCard

nodes.name: RSMUSCustomerList

nodes.name: RSMUSIWX Inventory Count Card

nodes.name: RSMUSIWX Inventory Count List
nodes.summary: Extends the IWX Inventory Count List page to add a 'Count Difference Analysis Variances' action that runs the custom RSMUSCountDifferenceAnalysis report filtered to the selected count.

nodes.name: RSMUSLicensePlate

nodes.name: RSMUSPackageWorksheet

nodes.name: RSMUSGeneralJournalBatches
nodes.summary: Extends the General Journal Batches page to add a Workflow Status field for approval workflow tracking.

nodes.name: RSMUSPurchaseJournals
nodes.summary: Extends the Purchase Journal page to expose Job Line Type, Job No., and Job Task No. fields for job-linked purchase entries, and adds a Vendor field column.

nodes.name: RSMUSCashReceiptsJrnl

nodes.name: RSMUSCustLedgerEntries
nodes.summary: Extends the Customer Ledger Entries page to add Customer Deposit and BizWiz sync flags, and provides a 'Send to BizWiz' action to transmit selected or all visible entries to BizWiz via the integration codeunit.

nodes.name: RSMUS Vendor Card
nodes.summary: Extends the Vendor Card page to add insurance compliance fields (General Liability and Workers' Comp expiration dates, COI received/start/end dates), a Subcontractor Agreement Received flag, and a Workflow Status field.

nodes.name: RSMUS Vendor List
nodes.summary: Extends the Vendor List page to surface insurance compliance columns (General Liability and Workers' Comp expiration dates, COI dates, Subcontractor Agreement Received) and Workflow Status alongside standard vendor fields.

nodes.name: RSMUSItemCard
nodes.summary: Extensively extends the Item Card page with custom fields for item type, drop shipment, countability, job-costable flag, NopCommerce order modifiers, vendor name, box/case/pallet quantities, BizWiz subcategory, portal status, workflow status, and a Zetadocs document fact box. Adds a 'Print Item Label' action and enforces item type consistency between item and its category.

nodes.name: RSMUSItemList
nodes.summary: Extends the Item List page to display portal status, drop shipment, countability, item type, BizWiz subcategory, secondary description, workflow status, and job-costable fields, plus integrates a Zetadocs related documents fact box.

nodes.name: RSMUSItemLedgerEntry
nodes.summary: Extends the Item Ledger Entries page to add a Reason Code field for auditing purposes.

nodes.name: RSMUS Phys. Inventory Journal
nodes.summary: Extends the Physical Inventory Journal to add custom 'Physically Counted Qty' and 'Physically Counted' fields while hiding the standard Quantity, Qty. (Calculated), and Qty. (Phys. Inventory) columns to streamline the counting workflow.

nodes.name: RSMUSGeneralJournal
nodes.summary: Extends the General Journal page with a placeholder for a Workday XML import action. The action body and associated XmlPort/Report calls are fully commented out, indicating planned but inactive functionality.

nodes.name: RSMUSSalesInvoiceCard
nodes.summary: Extends the Sales Invoice card to surface Applies-to document fields and adds a 'Submit to BizWiz' action for HTTP integration. The BizWiz trigger logic is commented out but the codeunit variable reference remains active.

nodes.name: RSMUSSales & Receivables
nodes.summary: Extends the Sales & Receivables Setup page to add a Canadian Company Name field to the General tab, supporting multi-company cross-border cost transfer requirements.

nodes.name: RSMUSJobsSetup
nodes.summary: Extends the Jobs Setup page to expose the Overpick Threshold Multiplier field, which controls the maximum allowed overpick quantity for job planning lines.

nodes.name: RSMUSSalesOrderSubform
nodes.summary: Extends the Sales Order Subform to add the SKU Cost field directly on order lines, making SKU-level cost flow information visible to order entry users.

nodes.name: JobTransferJobPlanningLine
nodes.summary: A standalone StandardDialog page (not a pageextension) that allows users to select a posting date, job journal template, and batch when transferring job planning lines to the job journal. It auto-resolves defaults via location-linked journal batches and the BizWiz integration setup.

nodes.name: RSMUSPurchaseOrder
nodes.summary: Extends the Purchase Order card to add the Order Created By Name field and hooks the Send Approval Request action to validate approval restrictions via the General Management codeunit before submitting.

nodes.name: RSMUSStockkeepingUnit
nodes.summary: Extends the Stockkeeping Unit Card with custom fields for portal status, foreman bonus, sales commission exclusion, priority, drop shipment, IC, and job costable flowfields. Also conditionally shows a Material Associations subform when the parent item is classified as a Product.

nodes.name: RSMUSStockkeepingUnits
nodes.summary: Extends the Stockkeeping Unit List page to show additional columns (Item No. 2, portal status, blocked status, item type, IC, job costable) and adds a Delete SKUs action that delegates bulk deletion to the BizWiz Integration codeunit.

nodes.name: RSMUSLocationCard
nodes.summary: Extends the Location Card with branch dimension, primary job location flag, BizWiz SKU creation restriction, default job journal batch, location logo, invoice/PO contact details, a staging-assembly bin code, and count analysis variance thresholds for physical inventory.

nodes.name: RSMUSGetReceiptLines
nodes.summary: Extends the Get Receipt Lines page to surface the originating Order No. field alongside the document number, making it easier to trace receipt lines back to their purchase orders.

nodes.name: RSMUSItemCategoryCard
nodes.summary: Extends the Item Category Card to add the Item Type classification field, allowing categories to be marked with the custom RSMUS item type for downstream rules.

nodes.name: RSMUSTransferOrder
nodes.summary: Extends the Transfer Order header page with drop shipment and comments fields, a Print BOL action that runs the Bill of Lading report against warehouse shipment lines, and automatic Qty. to Receive reset logic when navigating between orders.

nodes.name: RSMUSTransferOrderSubform
nodes.summary: Extends the Transfer Order Subform lines with an availability warning indicator (with drill-down to the RSMUS Avail Warning TO page), drop shipment fields, drop ship order drill-down to the linked purchase order, and SKU quantity on hand. Availability calculations delegate to the General Management codeunit.

nodes.name: RSMUSWarehouseReceipt
nodes.summary: Extends the Warehouse Receipt page to automatically reset Qty. to Receive to zero on all receipt lines whenever the user navigates to a different receipt document.

nodes.name: RSMUS Whse. Phys. Invt. Jnl
nodes.summary: Extends the Warehouse Physical Inventory Journal to add Physically Counted Qty and Physically Counted flag columns, while hiding the standard Quantity, Qty. (Calculated), and Qty. (Phys. Inventory) columns to streamline the count entry experience.

nodes.name: RSMUSBinContents
nodes.summary: Extends the Bin Contents page to display an 'Available to Schedule' quantity (with drill-down to the RSMUS Avail Warning Bin page) and the item description. The available quantity is computed via the General Management codeunit, accounting for open transfer orders and existing picks.

nodes.name: RSMUS Posted Invt Pick Subform
nodes.summary: Extends the Posted Inventory Pick Subform to surface the original material quantity and the overpick material quantity fields, supporting the OverPick for Jobs feature.

nodes.name: RSMUSJob
nodes.summary: Extensively extends the Job Card with BizWiz sync status, customer name and balance due, BizWiz job URL, planning location, service type, invoiced/credited indicator, secondary job number, location code, and a BizWiz sync error message panel. Also adds a Material Job Costing action and replaces the standard planning lines report.

nodes.name: RSMUSJobList
nodes.summary: Extends the Job List page with BizWiz cancellation status, secondary job number, sync status, starting/ending dates, customer name, planning location, customer balance due, service, product total, and invoiced/credited indicator. Adds a Material Job Costing navigation action.

nodes.name: RSMUSBusinessMgmtRoleCenter
nodes.summary: Extends the Business Manager Role Center to add an Integration Setup shortcut in the embedded actions area, providing quick access to the RSMUSIntegrationSetup page.

nodes.name: RSMUSJobLedgerEntries
nodes.summary: Extends the Job Ledger Entries list to surface Foreman Name and Inspector fields, supporting field service job costing visibility requirements.

nodes.name: RSMUSSalesInvoiceList
nodes.summary: Extends the Sales Invoice List to add a Delete Invoices action that leverages the BizWiz Integration codeunit for bulk deletion of highlighted or all visible sales invoice records.

nodes.name: RSMUSPurchaseOrderList
nodes.summary: Extends the Purchase Order List to display the Order Created By Name column and hooks the Send Approval Request action to enforce approval restrictions through the General Management codeunit for all selected orders.

nodes.name: RSMUS Planning Worksheet Line
nodes.summary: Extends the Planning Worksheet to add the Drop Shipment flag column after the Ref. Order Status field, making SKU-level drop shipment status visible during replenishment planning.

nodes.name: RSMUSWarehouseShipment
nodes.summary: Extends the Warehouse Shipment page to add custom comments and Ship-To address fields (code, name, address lines, post code, city, county, country) in the Shipping tab. Also contains a commented-out action to replace the standard Create Pick with a custom RSMUS version.

nodes.name: RSMUSApplCustLedgerEntry
nodes.summary: Extends the Apply Customer Entries page with a LoopPageRecs procedure that auto-applies customer deposit ledger entries to matching open entries using the CustEntry-Apply Posted Entries codeunit. Supports journal template/batch resolution via General Ledger Setup.

nodes.name: RSMUSPstedWhsShip
nodes.summary: Extends the Posted Whse. Shipment page to surface the custom RSMUS Comments field in the Shipping tab, mirroring the comments field added to the active Warehouse Shipment extension.

nodes.name: RSMUSRequeststoApprove
nodes.summary: Extends the Requests to Approve page to display the system-created timestamp (SystemCreatedAt) as a Requested Date/Time column, providing approvers with visibility into when each approval request was submitted.

nodes.name: RSMUSApprovalEntries
nodes.summary: Extends the Approval Entries page to insert a Requested Date/Time column (SystemCreatedAt) before the Sequence No. field, giving a consistent timestamp view alongside the Requests to Approve extension.

nodes.name: RSMUSPurchaseInvoice
nodes.summary: Extends the Purchase Invoice page to intercept the SendApprovalRequest action with a pre-action trigger that calls RSMUSGeneral Management to enforce custom approval restriction checks before the request is submitted.

nodes.name: RSMUSPurchaseInvoices
nodes.summary: Extends the Purchase Invoices list page to intercept SendApprovalRequest for multi-record selection, applying the same RSMUSGeneral Management approval restriction checks across all selected Purchase Header records.

nodes.name: RSMUSUserSetupExt
nodes.summary: Extends the User Setup page to expose the custom RSMUSShortcut Dimension 1 Code field after the Email field, allowing per-user default dimension assignment at the setup level.

nodes.name: RSMUS Invt. Pick Subform
nodes.summary: Extends the Inventory Pick Subform to hide the standard Qty. to Handle field and replace it with a custom RSMUS Qty. to Handle field, plus adds RSMUS Overpick Material Qty. and RSMUS Original Material Qty. fields to support the overpicking-for-jobs feature (BRD-0018).

nodes.name: RSMUSSalesInvoiceGW
nodes.summary: Custom Groundworks Sales Invoice report (2107 lines) using an RDLC layout, driven by the Sales Invoice Header data item. Renders posted sales invoices with full company branding, customer, and line detail for customer-facing distribution.

nodes.name: RSMUSDraftSalesInvoiceGW
nodes.summary: Custom Groundworks Draft Sales Invoice report (1538 lines) using an RDLC layout, driven by the Sales Header data item filtered to Invoice document type. Mirrors the posted invoice format for pre-posting preview and approval workflows.

nodes.name: RSMUSPurchase Order
nodes.summary: Custom Purchase Order report (1549 lines) using an RDLC layout, driven by the Purchase Header data item filtered to Order document type. Produces formatted purchase orders with full vendor and line detail for supplier distribution.

nodes.name: RSMUSWorkdayJob
nodes.summary: Processing-only report that imports pending and errored records from the RSMUSWorkdayImportBuffer table and creates General Journal Lines, validating G/L accounts and assigning document numbers via number series. Acts as the Workday-to-BC journal entry integration processor.

nodes.name: RSMUSJobCalculateWIP
nodes.summary: Processing-only report that iterates open Job records and invokes the standard Job Calculate WIP codeunit, then automatically chains to Post WIP to G/L. Extends the standard BC WIP calculation flow with Groundworks-specific automation.

nodes.name: RSMUSMaterialAssociationUpdate
nodes.summary: Processing-only report that traverses open Jobs and their Product-type Job Planning Lines to rebuild the planning line material association records (RSMUSPlanningLineMaterialAssoc), deleting stale associations and re-initializing product-material linkages for jobs without usage.

nodes.name: RSMUSJobResourceAndWIPPosting
nodes.summary: Processing-only report (437 lines) that processes BizWiz-completed jobs within the allowed G/L posting range, generating and posting job journal lines for resource costing and WIP, then closing completed jobs. Drives the automated end-of-job costing and WIP posting workflow.

nodes.name: RSMUSBillOfLading
nodes.summary: Custom Bill of Lading report using an RDLC layout, driven by Transfer Header with nested IWX LP Header (license plate) and line data items. Produces shipping documentation including transfer-from/to addresses, license plate details, and freight dimensions.

nodes.name: RSMUSBatchPaymentApply
nodes.summary: Processing-only report that batch-applies customer deposit ledger entries to matching transaction entries by iterating nested Cust. Ledger Entry data items, calculating pro-rated amounts, and calling CustEntry-Apply Posted Entries to perform the application.

nodes.name: RSMUSAgedAccountsReceivables
nodes.summary: Custom Groundworks Aged Accounts Receivables report (997 lines) with an RDLC layout, adding a 90-120 day aging bucket and a No. of Days column to the standard report. Supports detail/summary modes, local currency, and Excel export options.

nodes.name: RSMUS Create Pick
nodes.summary: Processing-only custom Create Pick report (393 lines) that processes Warehouse Shipment Lines, including assemble-to-order assembly lines, to create warehouse pick documents via the CreatePick codeunit. Replaces or supplements the standard BC pick creation for custom Groundworks picking workflows.

nodes.name: RSMUSWHIItemBarcodeLabel
nodes.summary: Warehouse Insight Item Barcode Label report (304 lines) based on an Insight Works template, using an RDLC layout. Generates barcode labels from both Item and Item Ledger Entry data items, supporting lot/serial tracking, quantity, UOM, and expiry date on labels.

nodes.name: RSMUS Phys. Inventory List
nodes.summary: Physical Inventory List report (483 lines) for warehouse count sheets, displaying item journal batch and line data with support for lot/serial numbers, calculated quantities, branch dimension filtering, and document/posting date headers.

nodes.name: RSMUSSetBranchPrimaryLocations
nodes.summary: Processing-only administrative report that auto-sets the RSMUSPrimaryJobLocation flag on Location records where a branch (RSMUS Dimension 1) has exactly one location, and reports branches with multiple locations that require manual designation.

nodes.name: RSMUSCountDifferenceAnalysis
nodes.summary: Count Difference Analysis report (1115 lines) based on the Insight Works IWX Count Sheet Line, using an RDLC layout. Reports counted vs. expected quantities and variance amounts per item/location, with options for description, detail rows, serial numbers, and a work-order text column added by Groundworks customization.

nodes.name: RSMUSCreatCountSheet
nodes.summary: Report extension (50104) for the 'IWX Create Count Sheets' report (23044300) that adds a request page option to exclude the Next Counting End Date from physical inventory count ranges per BRD-0029. Overrides the Next Counting End Date to a far-future date when the exclusion flag is set.

nodes.name: RSMUSLicensePlateLabel
nodes.summary: Report extension (50103) for the 'LPM License Plate Label' report (23044512) that adds 2D Data Matrix barcode generation, source document/number resolution, and ship-to city lookup from Warehouse Shipment or Pick activity lines per BRD-0007. Renders using a custom RDLC layout.

nodes.name: RSMUSPickingList
nodes.summary: Report extension (50100) for the standard 'Picking List' report (5752) that adds transfer-to location address columns (8-part), warehouse shipment number, and ship-from/to location code captions. Resolves address from Transfer Header via Warehouse Activity Lines.

nodes.name: RSMUSWarehouseShipment
nodes.summary: Report extension (50101) for the standard 'Whse. - Shipment' report (7317) that adds transfer-to location address columns (8-part) and ship-from/to location codes. Resolves destination address from Transfer Header via Warehouse Shipment Lines.

nodes.name: RSMUStransferHeaderBuffer
nodes.summary: Buffer table (50100) for staging Transfer Order header data during BizWiz API integration. Stores transfer-from/to codes, posting date, status, document number, and RSMUSIntegrationStatus for outbound transfer header payloads.

nodes.name: RSMUSIntegrationSetup
nodes.summary: Singleton setup table (50101) storing all configuration for the BizWiz and Workday integrations, including API base URL, credentials, journal template/batch references, posting groups, feature flags for job costing, WIP calculation, and invoice tracking.

nodes.name: RSMUSWorkdayImportBuffer
nodes.summary: Buffer table (50102) for staging Workday general journal import data. Holds G/L account, posting/document dates, document type, amount, description, journal batch references, and integration status before posting to Business Central general journals.

nodes.name: RSMUSBizWizSubcategory
nodes.summary: Custom item category/subcategory table (50103) captioned 'IMG Category' that mirrors BC's Item Category structure with parent-child hierarchy, presentation ordering, indentation, and cyclic inheritance detection. Used by the BizWiz integration to classify items.

nodes.name: RSMUSProductMaterialAssoc
nodes.summary: Association table (50104) linking product items to their constituent material items with quantity and unit of measure at a specific location. Used as a template to auto-generate job planning line material associations.

nodes.name: RSMUSPlanningLineMaterialAssoc
nodes.summary: Association table (50105) that records the relationship between product and material Job Planning Lines within a Job/Task, created from RSMUSProductMaterialAssoc templates. Enables tracking which material planning lines correspond to which product planning lines on a job.

nodes.name: RSMUS Assembly Order Process
nodes.summary: Core assembly process tracking table (50106) linked to BC Assembly Headers, storing assigned user, job number, quantities to assemble, rework quantities, output bin codes, and process status (Open/InProgress/Finished/Pause) for the pick-and-assembly streamlining workflow per BRD-0003.

nodes.name: RSMUS Assembly Process Steps
nodes.summary: Assembly process step detail table (50107) recording individual step executions (via 'RSMUS Step Option' enum) per assembly order and job number, capturing step date/time, quantities assembled, rework quantities, hourly rate, and duration.

nodes.name: RSMUS Assembly Order Cue
nodes.summary: Role center cue table (50108) providing FlowField counts of assembly orders by status (Open, InProgress, Finished, Paused, All) filtered by assigned user, used to drive the assembly worker role center activity tiles.

nodes.name: RSMUS Assembly Process Setup
nodes.summary: Minimal singleton setup table (50109) for assembly process configuration, storing the pick option (via 'RSMUS Process Pick Option' enum) that controls how warehouse picks are handled during the assembly streamlining workflow per BRD-0003.

nodes.name: RSMUS Assembly Process Finish
nodes.summary: Finished/posted assembly process archive table (50110) storing the completed state of assembly orders including item details, quantities, bin codes, and posted job number. Provides FlowField sums of assembled and rework quantities from the finished step records.

nodes.name: RSMUS Assembly Pro Step Finish
nodes.summary: Finished/posted assembly process step archive table (50111) mirroring Tab50107 structure for completed jobs, additionally keyed by Posted Job Number. Records the historical step-level quantities, rework, hourly rates, and durations after an assembly process is finished.

nodes.name: RSMUS Process Log
nodes.summary: Lightweight process execution log table (50112) recording process name, start/end timestamps, duration in milliseconds, and a process code â€” used for performance monitoring of background processes.

nodes.name: RSMUStransferLineBuffer
nodes.summary: Buffer table (50200) for staging Transfer Order line data during BizWiz API integration. Stores header reference, item number, quantity, unit of measure, and RSMUSIntegrationStatus as the line-level counterpart to Tab50100.

nodes.name: RSMUSDocumentAttachmentBuffer
nodes.summary: Buffer table (50300) for the BizWiz Document Attachment API page, storing attachment metadata (file name, type, extension, media reference) for any BC table/document combination, with document flow flags for purchase and sales transactions.

nodes.name: RSMUSWhShiptmentHeaderBuffer
nodes.summary: Buffer table (50400) for staging Warehouse Shipment header data during BizWiz API integration. Stores external document number, shipment date, source number, and RSMUSIntegrationStatus as the header counterpart to Tab50500.

nodes.name: RSMUSwhShipmentLineBuffer
nodes.summary: Buffer table (50500) for staging Warehouse Shipment line data during BizWiz API integration. Stores item number, source number, quantity shipped, and links back to the header buffer via Header Entry No., with RSMUSIntegrationStatus tracking.

nodes.name: RSMUSJobJournalLineBuffer
nodes.summary: Large buffer table (50501) mirroring the BC Job Journal Line structure for BizWiz integration, holding job number, posting date, document number, type (Resource/Item/G/L Account), and all associated cost, price, and dimension fields used when staging job journal entries from the BizWiz system.

nodes.name: RSMUSJobPlanningLineBuffer
nodes.summary: Buffer table (50502) mirroring BC Job Planning Line fields for use in integration and reporting scenarios, holding planning date, document number, type, cost/price amounts, resource group, unit of measure, location, and job task reference.

nodes.name: RSMUSItemBuffer
nodes.summary: Very large buffer table (50503) mirroring a comprehensive subset of BC Item table fields including descriptions, posting groups, unit prices, costing method, inventory tracking, and BOM flag, used for staging item data in BizWiz integration API responses.

nodes.name: RSMUSItemCategoryBuffer
nodes.summary: Custom temporary buffer table for item categories, mirroring standard category fields (Code, Parent Category, Description, Indentation, Presentation Order, Has Children) plus a custom RSMUSItemType enum field for item classification.

nodes.name: RSMUSJobErrorList
nodes.summary: Custom table for tracking job synchronization errors, storing the record system ID, table number, and last sync datetime to support BizWiz integration error logging.

nodes.name: RSMUSJobTask
nodes.summary: Extends Job Task with BizWiz integration fields (sync status, sync timestamps, task type), Foreman/Inspector fields for crew assignment, and a Location Code field that cascades updates down to Job Planning Lines.

nodes.name: RSMUSJobPlanningLine
nodes.summary: Extends Job Planning Line with overpicking quantity fields (original, overpick, posted), BizWiz sync status and timestamps, FlowField lookups for Foreman/Inspector from Job Task, item type filtering via SKU, and bill-to customer linkage.

nodes.name: RSMUSSalesInvoiceHeader
nodes.summary: Extends Sales Invoice Header with a Job No. field and a FlowField for Job Status derived from the linked Job record, enabling job-based invoice tracking.

nodes.name: RSMUSSalesInvoiceLine
nodes.summary: Extends Sales Invoice Line with a single GUID field to link each posted invoice line back to its originating draft invoice line for traceability.

nodes.name: RSMUSPurchInvHeader
nodes.summary: Extends Purchase Invoice Header with drop-ship transfer order reference, order creator ID (GUID), and a FlowField for the creator's full name, supporting drop-shipment and user audit workflows.

nodes.name: RSMUSLocation
nodes.summary: Extends Location with invoice/PO email and phone fields, a Branch dimension link, logo blob, BizWiz SKU restriction flag, material job costing batch, a staging-assembly bin, a Primary Job Location flag (enforcing one primary per branch), and count analysis variance fields.

nodes.name: RSMUSJob
nodes.summary: Extends Job with BizWiz integration fields (URL, sync status, timestamps, error blob, costing flags), a cascading Location Code field, customer balance due FlowField, product total FlowField, and service/costing completion indicators.

nodes.name: RSMUSJobLedgerEntry
nodes.summary: Extends Job Ledger Entry with Foreman Name and Inspector fields to carry crew assignment data through to posted job cost entries.

nodes.name: RSMUSGlEntry
nodes.summary: Extends G/L Entry with a Customer Deposit indicator enum, FlowField lookups for vendor and customer names from source number, and a direct Vendor text field for reporting.

nodes.name: RSMUSCustomer
nodes.summary: Extends Customer with an Active boolean flag (defaulting true) and a secondary numeric identifier field No. 2.

nodes.name: RSMUSCustLedgEntry
nodes.summary: Extends Customer Ledger Entry with a Customer Deposit enum indicator and a No Sync To BizWiz flag to control which entries are pushed to the external integration.

nodes.name: RSMUSLPHeader
nodes.summary: Extends the IWX LP Header (license plate header) with a Ship-to City field to support warehouse shipping display and reporting.

nodes.name: RSMUSWHIDocumentListBuffer
nodes.summary: Extends the WHI Document List Buffer with Foreman Name and Inspector fields to surface crew assignment data in warehouse document list views.

nodes.name: RSMUSGenJournalBatch
nodes.summary: Extends Gen. Journal Batch with a Workflow Status enum field to track approval workflow state on journal batches.

nodes.name: RSMUS Vendor
nodes.summary: Extends Vendor with insurance compliance fields (General Liability and Workers Comp expiration dates, COI received flag with COI start/end dates and validation rules), Subcontractor Agreement Received flag, and a Workflow Status field for approval processing.

nodes.name: RSMUS Planning Worksheet
nodes.summary: Extends Requisition Line (Planning Worksheet) with a Drop Shipment boolean flag to mark lines intended for drop-ship fulfillment.

nodes.name: RSMUSItem
nodes.summary: Extends Item with an RSMUSItemType classification enum, Drop Shipment flag, BizWiz subcategory code, NopCommerce order quantity limits, vendor name FlowField, portal visibility flag, IC flag, workflow status, box/case and pallet quantities, and a Job Costable indicator.

nodes.name: RSMUSSales & Receivables
nodes.summary: Extends Sales & Receivables Setup with a Canadian Company Name field (linked to Company table) to support inter-company transfer cost operations.

nodes.name: RSMUSJobsSetup
nodes.summary: Extends Jobs Setup with an Overpick Threshold Multiplier decimal field to configure the allowable overpicking percentage for job planning lines.

nodes.name: RSMUSItemLedgerEntry
nodes.summary: Extends Item Ledger Entry with a Reason Code field (linked to Reason Code table) to allow classification of inventory movements.

nodes.name: RSMUSSalesLine

tour.title: Extension Overview
tour.description: Start with app.json to understand the extension's identity and what it depends on. This RSM US LLP extension (v24.0.0.16, targeting BC 24 Cloud) declares four Insight Works dependencies (Warehouse Insight Advanced WMS, Dynamic Ship, License Plate Management, IWorks Common) and one Equisys dependency (Zetadocs), revealing that Groundworks runs a warehouse-intensive, document-delivery-focused operation. The custom ID range 50100–99999 scopes every object in this project. Pair this with the permission set to understand what access the extension grants, and the VS Code launch config to see the tenant environments in play (UAT, DEV, WHIIMPBRANCH).

tour.title: Integration Configuration — The Single Source of Truth
tour.description: Tab50101 RSMUSIntegrationSetup is a singleton configuration table (one row, no primary key beyond a single-record pattern) that stores every credential, URL, and toggle needed by the three external integrations: BizWiz field service, NopCommerce e-commerce, and Workday HR. Think of it as the extension's environment-variable store, read at runtime by every integration codeunit. Pag50100 is the setup card page that surfaces these fields to administrators. Whenever a new integration endpoint is added, this table and page are the first place fields land.

tour.title: The Event Subscriber Hub and General Utilities
tour.description: RSM's development standard is to centralise event subscribers into dedicated codeunits rather than scattering them across table and page extensions. Cod50104 RSMUSGeneralEventSubscribers (692 lines) is the primary hub: it subscribes to standard BC events across posting, transfer orders, warehouse operations, and more, then delegates to utility methods. Cod50105 RSMUSGeneralManagement (727 lines) is the shared utility library called from almost every other codeunit — it contains helpers for dimension defaulting, error handling, field mapping, and cross-table data propagation. Read these two files together to understand the backbone of all custom business logic.

tour.title: BizWiz Field-Service Integration Engine
tour.description: Cod50500 RSMUSBizWizIntegration (1958 lines) is the largest and most complex file in the codebase. It drives the two-way sync between Business Central and the BizWiz field-service platform: pushing customers, items, SKUs, jobs, job tasks, and job planning lines outbound via REST API calls, and pulling posted invoices and journal entries back in. Cod50503 RSMUSIntegrationFunctions holds lower-level HTTP and JSON helper routines, while Cod50502 RSMUSSingleInstanceCU provides a single-instance cache for auth tokens and setup values so repeated API calls do not re-read the database on every request. Together these three codeunits form the full BizWiz integration stack.

tour.title: Assembly Process Management
tour.description: Groundworks runs a manufacturing/assembly operation, and this subsystem adds a multi-step process workflow on top of standard BC assembly orders. Cod50114 RSMUSAssemblyProcessMgt (516 lines) orchestrates the lifecycle: creating process records, advancing steps, handling operator assignments, and triggering finish logic. Its data model spans several custom tables — Tab50106 Assembly Order Process, Tab50107 Assembly Process Steps, Tab50109 Assembly Process Setup, and Tab50110/50111 for finish and step-finish records. The companion events codeunit Cod50117 RSMUSAssemblyProcessEvents wires these actions into BC's standard assembly posting pipeline.

tour.title: Bank Reconciliation Automation
tour.description: Cod50121 RSMUSMatchBankRecLinesV2 (1050 lines) implements a custom bank statement line matching algorithm that replaces or supplements BC's built-in auto-match. It applies configurable tolerance rules, date windows, and amount-bucketing to pair imported bank lines against open ledger entries, then calls Cod50120 RSMUSBankAccEntrySetReconNoV2 to stamp reconciliation numbers on matched entries. Cod50119 RSMUSBankRecAutoMatch acts as the entry-point action handler, orchestrating the two lower codeunits and surfacing results to the user. This trio addresses a common pain point for high-volume bank accounts where the standard match rate is insufficient.

tour.title: API & Reporting Surface
tour.description: The extension exposes a REST API surface for NopCommerce (e-commerce) and BizWiz via OData-enabled API pages under src/Page/BizWiz APIs and src/Page/NopCommerce APIs. Key BizWiz endpoints expose Customers, Jobs, Job Task Lines, Job Planning Lines, SKUs, and Items. NopCommerce endpoints expose Transfer Headers/Lines and Warehouse Shipment data so the web store can track fulfilment. On the reporting side, report extensions customise the standard Picking List, Warehouse Shipment, and License Plate Label RDL layouts. The WHI Apps XML files configure Insight Works Warehouse Insight scanner workflows, making this layer the external-facing surface of the entire extension.
